querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      ann_date,
                                      f_info_bgndate,
                                      f_info_enddate,
                                      floating_bond_amount,
                                      floating_bond_amount_ratio,
                                      bondrepo_balance,
                                      bondrepo_balance_ratio,
                                      end_bondrepo_balance,
                                      end_bondrepo_balance_ratio,
                                      avg_remainder_period_max,
                                      avg_remainder_period_min,
                                      deviation_degree_frequency,
                                      deviation_degree_max,
                                      deviation_degree_min,
                                      deviation_degree_avg_value,
                                      fixed_deposit,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cmmquarterlydata.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cmmquarterlydata WHERE f_info_enddate BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
